observables.name: report_bytes_equal

observables.name: forbidden_words
observables.definition: occurrences of certificate, certified, certification or certify in the report (case-insensitive)

observables.name: consistency_mismatches
observables.definition: checks of the consistency section that report MISMATCH: package version across pyproject, COMPATIBILITY.md, CHANGELOG.md and the clean-install wheel name; every README row test of tests/test_readme_measurements.py; the README Meep block and MEEP_COMPARISON.md against the renderer; the RELEASE_SCOPE.md cells against the gate file

acceptance_limits.reproducible: report_bytes_equal is true and scope_drift is false on the committed tree, and --check exits 0
acceptance_limits.wording: the title reads 'internal validation report' and forbidden_words is 0
acceptance_limits.consistency: consistency_mismatches is 0; the report lists every gate task once and every G3 task once with the FAILED findings visible
